candidates.title: Benedict39: a second meal partitions the existing daily bread allowance rather than duplicating it
candidates.whole_reading: Set the daily allowance for each recipient. If there is only one meal, issue that allowance then. If there is a second meal, hold one third of the same allowance and serve it later. Add food for heavier work; reduce the allowance for children. Retain the separate weak/sick exception. This is source-owned English, not a Voynich translation.
candidates.generation_strategy: Treat captions as candidate identifiers for an allocated consumable or its owner; require the paragraph to bind an allowance owner and temporal scope, not describe the picture. A finite shared right-interface construction may close an allocation record while paid whole residuals distinguish daily, reserved and issued records. Do not identify which existing glyph supplies these meanings before root authoring.
candidates.multistep_consequence: Two meals share one daily quantity: later service changes allocation time, not the default daily total. A per-meal reading instead licenses two full allowances. The work/age exceptions must remain explicitly scoped, not erased to obtain conservation.
candidates.composition_obligation: Propose at most one shared typed aN operation within the licensed d+aN/qok+aN/ok+aN wholes if the chosen complete unit contains them. Pay their distinct payloads and whole residuals; track the same allowance owner. An aN number meaning or q imperative is not inherited.
candidates.frequency_obligation: A high-frequency form used as a daily allocation closer must have one grammar-defined function at repeated occurrences, including non-initial ones. Counts cannot prove that function or allow every occurrence to become a new allowance name.
candidates.eventual_falsifier: After freezing a complete whole reading and scope rules, reject it if two meals each create the full allowance while the same explicit daily owner is retained; or if a required reserved share belongs to another allowance under the same rules. No written numeral or independently bound meal is presently claimed.
candidates.begin_now: Exploratory authorship permitted: root can nominate an admitted complete unit and attempt this coherent reading with unknowns, before a discriminator is available.
candidates.not_ready_for_fixed_selection: No target allowance owner, meal field or unequal written consequence has been demonstrated by this producer. Source review and root nomination remain needed; this is not a fulfilled old reopening gate.
candidates.why_not_new_card: Exact conditional temporal partition is already760; stock/custody wording would also overlap372. No raw append warranted.

candidates.title: Assay acceptance sign releases an existing batch without creating a new product
candidates.whole_reading: Identify a stored batch. Take a sample from it; examine the sample for a stated sign. If that sign meets the criterion, accept the original batch for use; otherwise reject it. The observed sign is neither a new drug nor proof that the whole batch has been transformed. This is a proposed technical genre account, not an inspected historical assay or target translation.
candidates.generation_strategy: Caption identifies an existing batch/sample vessel, rather than a taxon. Paragraph instantiates SAMPLE_OF then OBSERVE then a guarded ACCEPT/REJECT statement. Shared morphology must preserve an observation/decision distinction and batch identity; names remain provisional, with unread groups explicit.
candidates.multistep_consequence: Acceptance changes permission/status of B while TEST changes what is known about sample S. A manufacturing account creates a new material output; an inventory merely lists B and S. These remain different under renaming because their event signatures and provenance duties differ.
candidates.composition_obligation: One finite directed construction may combine a property payload with an observation or decision frame; exact-whole residuals must prevent coercing a PropertySpec into a material output. The licensed aN family is a candidate place for record closure only, not evidence that it has that meaning.
candidates.frequency_obligation: A frequently recurring supposed assessment operator must retain its scope and valency across the authored unit. Rare batch names may stay C0; every unexplained frequent whole cannot be hidden in a catalogue.
candidates.eventual_falsifier: Freeze explicit sample provenance and criterion scope. Reject if the same construction consumes an observation as material, grants acceptance without the stated criterion, or shifts the decision to an unrelated batch. A mere coherent English assay does not select this account.
candidates.begin_now: Exploratory authorship permitted without a pre-existing independent assay graph. The author may attempt a complete admitted passage and document failure or observational equivalence honestly.
candidates.not_ready_for_fixed_selection: The raw856 definition lacks a complete named historical assay; IDEA637 has no independently owned target assay graph. Neither deficit bans exploratory generation, and neither gate is claimed fulfilled.
candidates.why_not_new_card: 856 already has this exact sample/criterion/original-batch mechanism; another raw assay card would duplicate it.

candidates.title: Procedural directives, attributed efficacy and delayed results in separate voice scopes
candidates.whole_reading: Prepare or attach the named plant-associated material to the stated recipient site. A named authority says this helps a particular condition; another use is reported as hearsay. A following direct claim concerns the leaf juice or distilled water, not automatically the earlier attached material. Keep the command, attributed efficacy and direct assertion separate. Source examples are distinct, not one attested combined prescription.
candidates.generation_strategy: Caption introduces a plant-associated item, site or product, without forcing a species name. Prose alternates instruction and attributed claim frames, with persistent explicit material/recipient arguments. Generate two whole readings in parallel: attributed proposition scope versus direct prescription scope; do not add a contradictory world-fact simply because a source reports it.
candidates.multistep_consequence: REPORT(authority,HELPS(x,p)) does not assert HELPS(x,p) outside that report. PREPARE(x) does not perform or endorse the reported treatment. Two contrary attributed claims can coexist without asserting P and not-P about one patient/time. Deleting the report operator changes assertion content, not only world nouns.
candidates.composition_obligation: A finite wrapper hypothesized as REPORT must accept a proposition, while instruction wrappers accept an action/schema. The same whole must retain its type and scope policy; formal paragraph/entry alternatives must remain a rival. A stem cannot be coerced from property to event solely to fit its exterior.
candidates.frequency_obligation: An alleged reporting/claim operator should have a limited reusable scope rule. Frequent medial wholes may serve that function but counts and Currier concentration do not choose it; an exact whole used as a plant name is a retained alternative.
candidates.eventual_falsifier: Freeze report closing and argument rules in the entire authored unit. Reject the candidate version if it silently asserts a proposition it only attributes, moves a claim to another product, or requires unmarked speaker switches. Retain a tie if both complete scope readings fit all exposed data.
candidates.begin_now: Most concrete source prior of the three. Root may authorize exploratory whole-passage authorship now, without confirming any operator or requiring an independent inequality first.
candidates.not_ready_for_fixed_selection: No target report operator or full reusable scope parser has been selected. The Galen499/501 view-lifetime, assertion and domain debts remain; replacing labels with REPORT is not a solution by itself.
candidates.why_not_new_card: 817 already explicitly separates imperative, attributed and delayed-result scopes. New attribution wording would duplicate it.
